saveErrors.rows_invalid: The document's structure is inconsistent. Reload the page, and contact support if it happens again. Submission is blocked until this is resolved.
saveErrors.node_too_deep: A node is deeper than the structure template's levels. Move it up a level; submission is blocked until then.

saveErrors.save_unavailable: The server cannot be reached right now. Your changes stay in the editor and saving is retried automatically.

live.frozen: Someone is submitting this version, so editing is paused. If the submission does not go through, editing resumes on its own.

workflow.title: Approval workflows
workflow.intro: A submitted program goes through the workflow's stages in order. Each stage has someone responsible (a person, or a role whose holders claim the task) and a time allowed in work days.
workflow.none: There is no approval workflow yet; programs cannot be submitted for review until an admin defines one.
workflow.resubmitRestart: starts again from the first stage
workflow.snapshotNote: Editing a workflow does not change a review in progress; each review follows the workflow as it was when submitted.
workflow.allOpen: Every open task in the organization
workflow.noTasks: No tasks are waiting for you.
workflow.resolvedMustFix: Must-fix comments marked resolved since the return ({{count}})
workflow.returnRule: Returning needs a decision note and at least one open comment on this version.

outcome.returned: This version was returned for changes; a new draft was created.

workflow.criticalReason: The content has critical findings. Write why you submit it anyway; the reviewer will see it.
workflow.noneForProgram: There is no approval workflow; ask an admin to define one.
workflow.confirmDeleteDefault: “{{name}}” is the default workflow; once it is deleted, programs that did not choose one cannot be submitted until another default is set. Delete it?
workflow.returnedWith: Version {{number}} was returned with these decisions
workflow.openProgram: Open the program and its new draft
workflow.confirmCancel: Cancel this version for good? Cancelling cannot be undone.
workflow.followsReturn: The program's draft answers the return of version {{number}}, so its submission follows that review's stages.

events.task_assigned: Review requested: stage “{{stage}}” of version {{number}} of “{{program}}” — due {{due}}
events.version_returned: Version {{number}} of “{{program}}” was returned for changes: {{note}}

events.task_due: The stage “{{stage}}” of “{{program}}” is due now
events.task_overdue: Escalation: the stage “{{stage}}” of “{{program}}” is late (responsible: {{responsible}})

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.intro: A code from an authenticator app on your phone, asked after your password. It works in all your organizations. Signing in through your organization's provider does not use it: the provider takes care of it.
mfa.stepApp: Install an authenticator app (such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator).
mfa.stepKey: Add an account in the app with this key:
mfa.stepLink: or open this link on the same phone:
mfa.stepCode: Type the code the app shows to confirm.

security.title: Sign-in security
security.mfaForManagers: Require two-factor authentication of admins and approvers
security.sessionHours: Single sign-on session length, in hours
security.domainsIntro: People whose email is in a domain the organization proved it owns, with a DNS record, sign in through its provider.
security.publishRecord: Add this record to the domain's DNS settings, then press “Verify”:
security.confirmRemoveDomain: Remove the domain {{domain}}? People with this domain will no longer sign in through the organization's provider.
security.providerIntro: Register Harak as an application with your organization's provider (Microsoft Entra ID, Google Workspace or another), and enter its details here.
security.secretKept: Stored; leave empty to keep it
security.changeClearsTests: Any change clears the test results and lifts enforcement until the provider is tested again.
security.connectionNotTested: The connection has not been tested yet.
security.testSignInDone: The test sign-in through the provider worked.
security.enabled: Allow signing in through the provider
security.emergencyHint: One admin keeps signing in with a password and mandatory two-factor authentication, in case the provider fails.
security.enforced: Enforce single sign-on (no passwords for the organization's members)
security.enforcedHint: Needs a passing connection test and test sign-in since the last change, and an emergency account with two-factor authentication.
